ORDINANCE

BE IT ORDAINED BY THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF CHICAGO:

SECTION I. Title 17 of the Municipal Code, the Chicago Zoning Ordinance, be

amended by changing all the B2-2 Neighborhood Shopping District

symbols and indications as shown on Map No. 1-H in the area bounded by:
105 feet north of and parallel to West Grand Avenue; a line 72 feet east of
and parallel to North Oakley Avenue; West Grand Avenue; and a line 48
feet east of and parallel to West Grand Avenue

to those of a C2-2 Motor Vehicle-Related Commercial District.

SECTION 2. This ordinance shall be in force and effect from and after its passage and

due publication.

Common Address of Property: 2254 West Grand Avenue
